**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `8a1fcc3`: all 6 files reviewed.

2 finding(s): 2 to consider; 2 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

The PR draws the take's recorded webcam over the Library's original player. To do this it pulls the editor's sync logic out into a shared `useWebcamSync` hook. It also adds a read-only `WebcamPlaybackLayer` that copies the main video's playback rate. The refactor keeps the editor's behaviour: same seek, gap and play/pause handling, and `path` is null only for the playback layer. `pictureBox` correctly matches `object-fit: contain` inside the 16:9 player. The tests cover where the bubble goes and its shape, gaps, playback rate, and the no-webcam case. I found no defects. There are two points to consider: a comment under the player that now undersells what the player shows, and the overlay's interaction with the native controls and fullscreen.

> ℹ️ No critical issues. One minor suggestion inline. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the whole PR: the face is now drawn over the Library's original player, and the editor's webcam sync logic moved into a shared hook. - **`WebcamPlaybackLayer` over the original player**: the webcam file is laid over the screen video at the sidecar's `recordedLayout`, seeded by the editor's own `seedWebcamScene`. It is hidden during `gaps` and stays in step through play, pause and seek. - **`useWebcamSync` extracted**: the editor's `WebcamLayer` and the new read-only layer share the per-frame placement and resync logic, through a shared `WebcamMedia` element. `path` is now nullable, and scale falls back to `1` when it is missing. - **Playback rate mirrored**: `apply()` copies the main element's `playbackRate`, and a `ratechange` listener applies it right away. This changes the editor too. - **`pictureBox` placement**: the layer covers the picture's own letterboxed or pillarboxed rectangle inside the 16:9 player. The read-only bubble uses `data-interactive="false"` and `pointer-events: none`, so clicks still reach the native controls. - **Tests**: page tests cover placement and shape, hiding in a gap and coming back after a seek, rate mirroring and a take without a webcam. Unit tests cover the `pictureBox` math.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/468?action=fix&review_id=5721879817) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/468?action=fix-approved&review_id=5721879817) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41182198913/job/124481716952) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

> ℹ️ No new issues in the merge. The earlier fullscreen/PiP thread on `recording-player.tsx` is still open. **Reviewed changes** Since the last review, the base branch was merged in (`c397515`). I checked how the conflicts in `recording-player.tsx` and the tests were resolved. - **Rename restore folded into the webcam player**: the base's NIW2-560 position/paused carry-over (`position`, `restoring`, `useLayoutEffect` on `id`) now sits next to the webcam layer. One `onLoadedMetadata` sets `frame` and restores the position after an `id` change, and neither job is lost. - **Media URLs through `mediaUrl`**: the screen and webcam sources are both built with `mediaUrl("recording" | "webcam", id)`, so the webcam URL also gets the workspace `w` param. A rename moves `.webcam.mp4` together with the item, so the webcam `src` follows `id` correctly. - **ADR citations renumbered**: the comments in `recording-player.tsx` and `webcam-layer.tsx` now cite ADR 0037 instead of 0032. - **Tests merged**: `recording-player.test.tsx` keeps the base's rename tests and this PR's `pictureBox` tests. I ran the touched suites locally (21 files, 212 tests) and they pass.
